fresh_g6_regression.scope_note: The 11 browser/native-host commands were omitted only under the approved unchanged-source, dependency, and output condition. This is not UI behavior or authentication acceptance.

current_source_and_index.result: The 352-entry private G6 candidate source ZIP matches the captured source map and current disk except for the documented derivative docs/ifpmic/progress.json update. privacy_and_runtime_evidence.result: The G6 public archive excludes private source/build archives, original uploads, and raw worker/service logs. I scanned public G1-G6 archives for absolute workspace paths, database/secret markers, and synthetic OIDC canaries; none were present. G6 private gate files are mode 0600 under a mode 0700 directory. Its G5 workspace observation records 42 unique PID/start-tick identities, all stopped, and all 84 retained stdout/stderr files match their recorded sizes and hashes under private permissions.

requirements_and_boundaries.result: The manifest preserves direct REQ-13 and partial AT-21 scope, with REQ-02/05/11/12/14 preserved. It distinguishes local auth, API, database, workspace readiness, and isolation evidence from real corporate SSO, proxy redaction, production grants/database/backup policy, Temporal execution, live UI/SSE/artifact integration, device integration, and release acceptance.

independent_checks.verification_performed_by_reviewer: Read-only inspection, SHA-256 verification of manifest pins, G1-G5 archive membership and entry digests, G6 source ZIP/current/index reconciliation, G6 archive privacy scan, and G5 process/log-file identity and digest checks. No tests, builds, services, databases, or network operations were run.
